ios.desc:
Grangou connects food lovers for real-life dining experiences. Say goodbye to eating alone and hello to shared meals with like-minded people at great local restaurants.

Create Mode:
Plan a meal with people you already know. Start a table, share your invite link or code, and let Gou handle restaurant and timing so your group can focus on showing up hungry. Perfect for friends, coworkers, or anyone you want at the same table.

Surprise Me:
Ready to meet someone new over food? Surprise Me uses your profile and preferences to suggest compatible dining partners and a restaurant that works for everyone. This tab unlocks after you’ve created a table and it’s open so you can host your crew first, then explore spontaneous matches when you’re ready.

What you get:
- AI-powered matching for tastes, dietary needs, budget, and schedule
- Location-aware restaurant and meetup suggestions
- Personalized profile and dining preferences
- Match and table history, safety tools, and privacy controls
- Secure sign-in with Sign in with Apple

Subscriptions:
Grangou is free to download. Optional premium plans offer more matches and tables.
- Monthly plan – billed monthly, renews automatically, cancel anytime.
- Quarterly plan – billed every 3 months, renews automatically, cancel anytime.
- Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings or via the subscription section in the app.

Legal:
Terms of Use: https://www.grangouapp.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.grangouapp.com/privacy-policy
